The Qashiriyyah Epistle is a comprehensive work by Abd al-Karim ibn Hawwasan ibn Abd al-Malik al-Qushayri, a renowned Sufi scholar. The book delves into the core beliefs and practices of Sufism, emphasizing tawhid (monotheism) and the spiritual journey towards God. Throughout the epistle, Al-Qushayri underscores the importance of seeking knowledge and wisdom through reflection and contemplation, while maintaining humility and reliance on Allah.
